scale: 0-100 when evaluable; null/UNKNOWN when not evaluable
principles: Evidence version is independent from scoring version
NO_EVALUATION_FOUND is not zero and does not imply no threat
All source assessments remain preserved outside the scoring projection
Latest assessment is selected only within comparable source/scope logical units
Differences across territories, dates or independent sources are not conflicts by themselves
Where a true same-unit conflict remains, the precautionary maximum severity is used and the conflict flag is retained

aggregation.description: Compute weighted assessment scores after within-unit temporal selection. Final score = 0.8 * maximum weighted assessment + 0.2 * mean of the three highest weighted assessments from distinct logical units. With one assessment this equals that assessment score.

conflict_policy.same_unit_same_version_incompatible_cate: UNRESOLVED_CONFLICT; retain all records; scoring projection uses precautionary maximum evaluable severity

rationale: The module measures collection urgency attributable to documented extinction risk for a La Rioja botanical programme. Local/regional evidence is therefore most relevant, national Spanish evidence remains strong, continental/global evidence is supportive, and threat assessments from unrelated European territories are retained but down-weighted. Temporal attenuation avoids treating old assessments as equally current without discarding historically valid evidence. DD receives a precautionary intermediate value but remains explicitly distinguishable from threatened categories.
